episodes.title: Refresh: Roch Theriault and the Ant Hill Kids
episodes.description: Episode 445: In 1978, a charismatic Quebec health lecturer, Roch Thériault, led a small band of devoted followers into the wilderness of the Gaspé Peninsula, declared himself Moses, and promised them a new world rising from the ashes of the old. What followed was a decade of escalating control, staged "operations," and violence, including mutilation and murder, that culminated in a Kawartha Lakes commune known to police as the Ant Hill Kids. This week, we revisit one of Dark Poutine's most requested refresh cases with fresh eyes. From a welfare caseworker's office in Orillia to a Kingston courtroom to a locked-down medium-security penitentiary in New Brunswick, this is the full history of a man who called himself a prophet, and how it all came to an end. episodes.title: Road Trip: Deadly Prophecy — The Children of Thunder
episodes.description: Episode 396: In this episode, we learn about an enigmatic narcissistic psychopath who led the Californian cult called The Children of Thunder. Glenn Taylor Helzer, and the other leadership was comprised of his brother Justin Helzer and their follower Dawn Godman. Raised in a strict Mormon home, Taylor’s life spiralled after years of mental health trouble. By 2000, the trio had formed a cult under Taylor’s delusional leadership. That summer, they murdered Ivan and Annette Stineman, Selina Bishop (daughter of guitarist Elvin Bishop), Jennifer Villarin, and James Gamble. The crime spree and investigation shocked authorities and families, exposing how Taylor twisted faith and loyalty into violence.
